description: This file is a Node.js server script using Express.js framework. It sets up a web server with two endpoints: a health check at '/health' and a root endpoint '/' that provides a static response. It binds the server to a port specified by environment variable or default 3001 and logs a message when the server starts.

methods.name: app.get('/health')
methods.description: Defines a health check endpoint that responds with a JSON indicating server health status.

methods.name: app.get('/')
methods.description: Defines a root endpoint that responds with a static status message.

methods.name: app.listen()
methods.description: Starts the server listening on the specified port and logs a message.
